en: Sepia-toned, oval-framed image of a three‑story lodging house with balconies and many people gathered in front of it, likely a group portrait of guests and staff. The facade bears a sign with the building's name in German. Under the image there is printed German text identifying the house as a lodging establishment called "Logierhaus grauer Schwan" in Warmbrunn, Silesia.
